# AgentMesh Core Design

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root as the single source of truth for AI
assistant instructions and design guardrails.

Before changing design docs or architecture-facing code, inspect the active
Markdown listed in the Documentation Map in `AGENTS.md`. Keep implementation
boundaries, product language, deployment notes, and interview-facing explanations
aligned.

Keep functional behavior in `docs/agent-runtime-functional.md` and
non-functional qualities in `docs/agent-runtime-non-functional.md`.
